bio: Located in the pedestrianised streets of the beautiful baroque city of Győr, this long-standing restaurant fits in perfectly thanks to its traditional, low-key elegance. Head past the bistro area at the front to the bright room behind, where they serve a menu which mixes Hungarian, Mediterranean and even some subtle Thai influences. The bright, vibrant dishes come in generous portions, with well-judged flavours – be sure to save room for a comforting dessert such as the gundel or zsabo pancakes. The smart pavement terrace is a hit come summer....
